summary: The index is composed of the constituents of the S&P 500® Shariah Index other than those from the following sub-industries: Aerospace & Defense, Financial Exchanges & Data, and Data Processing & Outsourced Services. The manager attempts to invest all, or substantially all, of its assets in the component securities of the index. Under normal circumstances, at least 80% of the fund's total assets will be invested in sharia companies that are component securities of the index. It is non-diversified.
